node.statement: By GT-kitaev-fd-cstar-structure, the finite-dimensional unital C*-algebra B is *-isomorphic to direct-sum_{j=1}^m B(L_j) for some integer m>=1 and nonzero finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces L_j; transport Delta through this *-isomorphism and henceforth identify B with that direct sum.
